notes.title: The Legacy Demo Patch 1. An opportunity to be reborn. Development Diary #6.
notes.content: [p]We're excited to announce an important patch for The Legacy Demo![/p][p]Thank you to everyone who leaves feedback on Steam and takes our short survey, we study every feedback in detail and improve the game for you.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3112550/The_Legacy_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109069/add3429a4026677c3fd4b56ad833a3141ae250b8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109069/8afba5b654c5796f956186265725266756aa69c4.png"][/img][/p][p]In this patch some things have been fixed, plus we added some very important things such as: an option to enable/disable the ability to revive after death, a slider to customize background sounds that were too loud in the background, added a lot of useful hints and more![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109069/d03043dc94984734c2421fd4c362c9f66d77d0ec.png"][/img][/p][h3]Changes:[/h3][list][*][p]Added a slider to customize ambient sounds; [/p][/*][*][p]Removed headshots to the head from cold weapons, head damage is now ×3;[/p][/*][*][p]Putting on a mask now displays the effect on the screen;[/p][/*][*][p]Added a reset button for filters;[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the user interface of filters - it is now more user-friendly and clearer;[/p][/*][*][p]Added a hint on how to reanimate the player in the “Death” state UI;[/p][/*][*][p]More rocks have been added in the vicinity of Svetlograd;[/p][/*][*][p]More red barrels added to the map;[/p][/*][*][p]Day length increased to 40 minutes;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bugs with hands in night vision mode and underwater effect;[/p][/*][*][p]Added tooltip animation when opening inventory for the first time after picking up a book.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced zombie, player and soldier background artwork in the vault;[/p][/*][*][p]Stove now displays a tooltip on how to fire it up;[/p][/*][*][p]Added in-game revival option;[/p][/*][*][p]Added a tooltip about green smoke defense;[/p][/*][*][p]Cargo loot has been rebalanced;[/p][/*][*][p]Inventory chat became more visible and readable;[/p][/*][*][p]Occasionally the snake would play the sound of a boar - Fixed;[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced vampire and witch health, now they are 10-15% harder to kill;[/p][/*][*][p]Added a few new screemer sounds;[/p][/*][*][p]In the starting control panel - Added information on how to get resources;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bugs in Dutch language.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109069/e5ded95467aeff61b33aab5a677fb7bb02cb6896.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Legacy Demo is available now. Development Diary #5.
Developers diary № 4.
Dev Log № 3.
notes.content:
We want to thank everyone who participated in the [b]Play Test[/b], testing and your feedback - gave us a lot of useful information, we have taken your feedback into account and are almost finished working on fixes, added a lot of new things, both in the demo version and in the upcoming full game.
A few times, even played with random players, it was fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109069/8506058e51b171e6bdbe9e47ced624e8b0489eb5.png[/img]

[b]We are currently finalizing the new version of The Legacy, and will most likely start Play Test #2. After that, we plan to fix the remaining minor issues and start releasing the demo version.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109069/9d58c3d603553a309111dfce80561843de8eb05c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109069/5292e95110ee729210d1a78d30bedee269c97b49.png[/img]

[b]In the meantime, we'd like to share a list of recent changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Performance optimization, the game runs better, work on optimization continues;
[*] Added marker over players who are on death.
[*] Added indicators on all items to make it easier to find loot.
[*] Added special indicators on dead animals.
[*] Added tooltip on bush damage.
[*] Added tooltip when picking up a page without a book.
[*] Added ability to unload ammo from weapons.
[*] Book moved from the lake to a new location.
[*] Updated the button tooltip bar at the bottom, added the ability to disable the bar via settings.
[*] Added single player game.
[*] Added radio, you can now find the radio and turn on music in some locations;
[*] Added a button to reconnect when lost.
[*] Added voice chat in game.
[*] Fixed zombie synchronization.
[*] Customized tree LODs.
[*] Fixed room display, rooms are now displayed correctly.
[*] Dead soldiers are removed after a while.
[*] Rewritten animal logic, now they work more stable;
[*] Increased character limit in chat.
[*] Fixed the UI window for buying from a merchant.
[*] Increased range of sound on guitar.
[*] Fixed slider display over enemies.
[*] Fixed building and item placement system.
[*] Some animals have been replaced - bear, boar, fox and deer.
[*] Fixed changing of the same type of items in hands
[*] Fixed bug with hovering icons of items on the screen.
[*] Fixed a bug where a bear got stuck in rocks at a construction site.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would freeze when loading.
[*] Replaced fishing houses.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Log №2. Play Test and Demo is coming soon.
Dev report. The main things for the August.
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
Hopefully you've already had a chance to register for [b]Play Test The Legacy[/b] because it will be launching soon, after that - The Legacy Demo will be released where you can explore, try and just enjoy the game with your friends or strangers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109069/a85739662cd72f970e52b21e9e585f424a1116ca.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109069/2109d232f9e6420f6e93c89d9abba4b20586001f.png[/img]

Thanks to early testing - you will be able to try out the game soon, and we will be able to understand what needs to be fixed, added or balanced, because the game is big, there are a lot of mechanics, and we plan to expand them further, we have room to grow.

Players are all different and everyone has their own view on the ideal cooperative survival horror, we will try to take into account all wishes and make the best possible product.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109069/4360966c1bc108e48d14531456336fb3e94a6691.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109069/67b409988bfac1db9e414024cd04341eb12a08fd.png[/img]

Below will be a list of changes, improvements, show our progress for August.
About 200+ tasks were done last month, but the list will include the most important ones.

- Added new weapons and sounds.
- Added new achievements, now there are 47 of them. 
- Expanded the range of items at the merchant.
- Merchant can now give tasks for a fee.
- Added bushes with berries that can be collected. 
- Replaced the weather and lighting system.
- Added difficulty levels. 
- Added a new entity, the shaggy monster. 
- Added a sectarian lair. 
- Installed building name plates. 
- Balanced the animals. 
- Added new clues. 
- Added zones and information about which zone the player has entered. 
- Cursed locals now react to critical damage. 
- Added a compass on the map if you have one in your inventory.
- Replaced some sounds.
- Updated the player list in the pause menu after a player dies or is logged out.
- Added slider above the heads of cursed locals displaying damage. 
- Fixed bugs with animals.
- Added green zone activity timer on the terrain map(chemical contamination zone) 
- Added weapon damage information. 
- Added information on ammo about which weapon it fits to. 
- Saving entities at night, worked incorrectly.
- Reworked the system of hints. 
- Ability to draw water in glass bottles.
- Dead raven is now illuminated, now easier to spot on the ground.
- Some food is a little thirst quencher.
- Added starting loot for characters. 
- Terrain map can be placed in a separate slot for quick access via hotkey. 
- Added display of hydrants on the terrain map. 
- Balanced weapon damage. 
- Added the ability to sort items in chests and inventory.
- Simplified the money storage system. 
- Balanced the prices of goods at the merchant.
- Added display of headshots. 
- Simplified the system of adding wood to the fire. 
- Added new slots for clothing and equipment. 
- Added an additional bag that increases quick access and carrying capacity by 3 slots. 
- Added a new potion called Revival.
